column1: Operating Steel Capacity (TTPA) by Production Method in Each Country/area
Global Iron and Steel Tracker, September 2026 (V1)
This data is based on the Global Iron and Steel Tracker, updated March 2026 with limited quarterly updates performed in June and September 2026 (Download here)
Units of measurement: thousand tonnes per annum (ttpa)
1) Total operating capacity excludes plants that are in development (announced/construction) or stopped (retired/mothballed/cancelled)
2) Integrated total includes all plants with both iron and crude steelmaking facilities, regardless of equipment type
3) Non-integrated total includes all plants with crude steelmaking facilities, but no ironmaking facilities on site
4) Other/unspecified includes plants with unknown steelmaking production methods as well as less common production methods such as OHF
